body: ## Problem Sales reps must leave the Power Dialer and open a person's profile to send a follow-up email. This interrupts call wrap-up when Task, Text and Book meeting are already available there. Closes ENG-15846 ## Solution Add Email to the existing next-step controls and open the shared CRM email composer for the current person. Keep wrap-up paused while the composer is opening and while its dialog is active. ## Scope - In: Email from session wrap-up and the ordinary completed-call dock, opening feedback, repeated-click protection and stale-contact protection. - Out: changes to email delivery, scheduling, templates, providers or calling behavior. These remain in their existing flows; no additional features are proposed here. ## Blast radius The shared next-step controls also serve ordinary calls, and the email-opening hook is used by My Day, People and Conversations. Its existing call signature remains compatible; focused tests cover workspace/person changes, unmounting and overlapping requests. Existing dialog holds and other next-step actions are retained. ## How it works ### Power Dialer wrap-up and completed-call dock Email uses the existing composer and contact lookup. Preparation holds prevent auto-advance during loading, and obsolete lookups cannot open a composer after the person or workspace changes. Missing email addresses use the existing error feedback. ```mermaid flowchart LR Wrap[Call wrap-up] --> Email[Choose Email] Email --> Prepare[Load current person and hold wrap-up] Prepare --> Composer[Existing email composer] Composer --> Close[Send or close] Close --> Resume[Resume existing wrap-up rules] ``` ## Verification - Four focused Vitest suites: **92 tests passed**, covering the Email action, error handling, stale responses and preparation-to-dialog holds. The web typecheck and mandatory pre-push typecheck passed (53 tasks); changed-file lint/format, v2 design checks, React Doctor and file-growth checks passed. - `bun run ci`, `bun run workflows:injection`, `bun run workflows:secrets`, `bun run check:web-test-placement` and `bun test ./.github/scripts/check-agent-docs.test.ts`: passed. - Local live QA on this head: one connected 19-second call, one Google email with user-confirmed receipt, one matching CRM message and a saved Answered outcome visible after reload. Email was opened from the actual completed-call dock. Earlier component-fixture checks cover missing-email/stale-opening guards and both themes at 390, 1440, 1650 and 1920 px. A minor keyboard focus-return defect remains; see the [QA report](https://github.com/Acquisity/Acquisity/pull/7638#issuecomment-6361725314). ## Copy review | Copy | Purpose | | --- | --- | | Email | Names the follow-up action beside Text. | | Opening email… | Explains the disabled loading state. | | Getting the next step ready. One moment. | Describes the shared email/meeting preparation hold. | ## Notes - Schema / environment changes: none. No new dependencies, application files or test files. - Agent docs: updated `docs/agents/telephony.md`; no new product terms. - Preview: default; the UI changes qualify for the normal preview build. - Evidence: screenshots were captured and inspected locally. They are not attached because the installed GitHub CLI lacks media-upload support. No full-flow video was captured. - Not tested: the separate live Power Dialer session/Auto-next path, normal-member permissions and unavailable-mailbox/blocked-recipient rejection. Keyboard Enter opens Email and Escape closes it, but focus returns to the page body. Full local unit, database, integration and production-build runs were skipped because this change adds no backend, database or dependency contracts. - How to QA: 1. Complete a controlled dialer call to a person with an email address; expect Email among the next steps. 2. Select Email; expect the correct recipient and no auto-advance while loading or composing. 3. Send one controlled email and confirm receipt and history, then confirm wrap-up resumes after the dialog closes. 4. Repeat with a missing address and with a person change during loading; expect feedback or cancellation, with no stale composer. - Merge danger: the UI and opening guards can be reverted, but emails sent through the shortcut cannot be unsent. Blast radius: dialer wrap-up and existing CRM email-composer entry points. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith with what you need. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added an email option to the dialer’s wrap-up next steps. The composer opens for the current contact and shows a busy state while preparing. * **Bug Fixes** * The dialer now pauses advancing to the next call while an email or meeting is being prepared, and remains paused while the related dialog is open. * Outdated email-opening requests no longer interfere with newer requests or show errors after the contact or workspace changes, or after the component closes.
title: feat(crm): email from Power Dialer wrap-up
